title: 🌟 CSS Hover Effect Buttons with Animated Text! 🎨✨
description:
Hey folks! 🎉 I just created some awesome animated buttons using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! 🚀
When you hover over a button, the text moves up smoothly with a glowing effect. 🔥

✅ Features:
✔️ Customizable colors 🎨
✔️ Cool glowing hover effect 💡
✔️ Smooth text animation 🔠
✔️ Beginner-friendly 👨‍💻

Check out the code and let me know what you think! 👀
